create_average_meter: create an AverageMeter instance to track and compute running averages of training metrics
update_average_meter: update an AverageMeter with new values and batch sizes to maintain running statistics
display_progress_meter: display a ProgressMeter to show batch progress and associated metric meters during training
compute_accuracy_topk: compute top-k classification accuracy from model output logits and ground truth target labels
reset_average_meter: reset an AverageMeter to clear all accumulated values and start fresh tracking
